m: रशना f. (prob. connected with रश्मि and राशि and derived from a lost √ रश्) a rope, cord, strap
rein, bridle
girth, girdle, zone (esp. of woman), RV. &c. &c. (also fig. applied to the fingers; cf. Naigh. ii, 5)
a ray of light, beam, ŚāṅkhBr.
the tongue (w.r. for रसना), L.
(ifc.) girt by, dependent on Hariv.; BhP.
a: रशना, रसना — [अश्-युच् रशादेशः cf. Uṇ. 2. 75] 1 A rope, cord. --2 A rein, bridle. --3 A zone, girdle, woman's girdle; रसतु रसनापि तव घनजघनमंडले घोषयतु मन्मथनिदेशं Gīt. 10; R. 7. 10, 8. 58; Me. 35. --4 The tongue; Bv. 1. 111. --Comp. --उपमा a variety of the figure उपमा; it is ‘a string or series’ of comparisons’ which consists in making the Upameya in the first comparison the Upamāna in the second, and so forth; see S. D. 664. --गुणः the cord of a girdle.

k.v: साक्षराङ्गुलिमुद्रा स्यात्कङ्कणं करभूषणम्. स्त्रीकट्यां मेखला काञ्ची सप्तमी रशना तथा॥

m: रशना—गु˚णास्पद n. ‘place for the c˚ of a g˚’, the waist, Kum.
रशना—गुण m. the cord of a girdle
रशना—कलाप or रशना—कला˚पक, m. a woman's girdle formed out of several strings or threads, Kāv. (cf. रश्मि-कलाप).
रशना˚कृत (˚नाक्˚) mfn. guided or led by a cord or bridle, Kauś.
रशना—पद n. ‘place for the girdle’, the hip, L.
रशनाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते (only p. रशनायमान), to be guided by a rein, AV.
रशन in comp. for रशना
रशन—सम्मित (˚न-) mfn. as long as the rope (on the sacrificial post), TS.; ĀpŚr.
रशनोपमा f. ‘string of comparisons’, a form of simile (when the object to which anything is compared is made the subject of another comparison, which again leads to a third and so on), Sāh.
रश्मी-वत् mfn. = रश्मि-वत्, VS.
रश्मन् m. = रश्मि
only in instr. रश्मा (RV. vi, 67, 1) and ifc. (cf. अ-रश्मन् and स्थारश्मन्).

m: रश्मि m. (exceptionally f.; cf. रशना and Uṇ. iv, 46) a string, rope, cord, trace, rein, bridle, leash, goad, whip (also fig. applied to the fingers), RV. &c. &c.
a measuring cord, RV. viii, 25, 18
a ray of light, beam, splendour, RV. &c. &c.
= अन्न, food, VS. xv, 16
= पक्ष, or पक्ष्मन्, L.
a: रश्मिः — [अश्-मि धातो रुट्, रश्-मिवा; cf. Uṇ. 4. 46] 1 A string, cord, rope. --2 A bridle, rein; मुक्तेषु रश्मिषु निरायतपूर्वकायाः Ś. 1. 8; रश्मिसंयमनात् Ś. 1. --3 A goad, whip. --4 A beam, ray of light; Ś. 7. 6; N. 22. 56; so हिमरश्मि &c. --5 An eyelash. --6 A measuring cord. --7 A finger (Ved.). --Comp. --कलापः a pearl-necklace of 54 threads. --मुचः the sun.

k.v: किरणोऽस्रमयूखांशुगभस्तिघृणिरश्मयः। भानुः करो मरीचिः स्त्रीपुंसयोर्दीधितिः स्त्रियाम्.।
किरणप्रग्रहौ रश्मी कपिभेकौ प्लवङ्गमौ। इच्छामनोभवौ कामौ शक्त्युद्योगौ पराक्रमौ॥

m: रश्मिधार m. a charioteer, Bcar.
रश्मि—शत-सहस्र-परिपूर्ण-ध्वज m. N. of a Buddha, Buddh.
रश्मि—जाल n. a net or garland of rays, VarBṛS.
रश्मि—कलाप m. a pearl-necklace consisting of 54 or 56 threads, VarBṛS.
रश्मि—केतु m. ‘beam-bannered’, a partic. comet, ib.
N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
रश्मि—क्रीड m. N. of a Rākṣasa, R.
रश्मि—मालिन् mfn. encircled or garlanded with rays, R.
the sun, L.
रश्मि—मण्डल n. a circle or garland of rays, AV.Pariś.
रश्मि—मत् mfn. having rays or beams, radiant, R.
रश्मि—मत् m. the sun, MBh.
N. of a man, Kathās.
रश्मि—मय mf(ई)n. formed or consisting of rays, BhP.
रश्मि—मुच m. ‘ray-emitting’, the sun, MBh.
रश्मिन् (ifc.) = रश्मि, a rein, bridle, BhP.
रश्मि—प m. pl. N. of a partic. class of deceased ancestors, VP.

रश्मि—पति m. Calotropis Gigantea, L.
रश्मि—पवित्र (˚मि-), mfn. purified by rays or beams, TBr.
रश्मि—प्रभास m. N. of a Buddha, Buddh.
रश्मि—पुञ्ज m. a heap or mass of rays, VP.
रश्मि—राज m. ‘ray-lord’, N. of a man, Buddh. (cf. रश्मि-पति).
रश्मि—रस-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.

रश्मि—वत् m. the sun, MBh.
